$comment: Cursor auto-coordination hooks (schema v1). Ships WITH the repo so it works on any machine with no ~/.cursor change; the command resolves the repo root via git so the path is portable. Cursor has no plugin marketplace, so coordination is delivered as a project hook here (not a plugin install like Claude Code / Codex). The hook self-gates on .rally/ presence (silent no-op if absent) and fail-opens (never blocks). Cursor's schema only injects an agent-visible message on preToolUse (agent_message); sessionStart/stop run rally side-effects (enter/next) with no visible output. Advisory by default; RALLY_HOOK_STRICT=1 turns preToolUse into a deny on high-severity collisions. See docs/AUTO-COORDINATION-HOOKS.md.
